flameShrinesAndSanctums.label: Flame Shrines and Sanctums
flameShrinesAndSanctums.description: Allow map travel to revealed Flame Shrine and Flame Sanctum markers. The game uses one marker type for both.

allowIntoShroud.label: Allow destinations in the Shroud
allowIntoShroud.description: Required before Shroud destination categories such as Gem Forges can be enabled.

gemForges.label: Gem Forges
gemForges.description: Allow map travel to revealed Gem Forge markers when Shroud destinations are enabled.

groups.label: Map destinations
groups.description: Travel settings are applied at game startup. Selected markers are hidden by the game's fog until the map area is uncovered.
